name: Mart Simulator
desc:
🍅Welcome to Mart Simulator🍅

Are you ready to run your own Mini Mart? Buy seeds from the shop when they restock, plant them, wait for them to grow. Stock shelves, set prices as you'd like, take payments, hire staff, expand and design your store. 

[How to play]
Buy seeds from the shop.
Plant seeds.
Take the fruits or productions to the shelves. 
Sell it for earning money.
